body.description: Keep every shape, size, position and the camera angle exactly as drawn; only redraw the surfaces, wood grain, stone, weave, cloth and plants in a careful hand-drawn pixel style. Do not add any object, cloth, sign, lettering or decoration that is not in the drawing. A village laundry line: two weathered wooden posts with a sagging rope between them and five plain cloths hung to dry in muted red, oatmeal, ochre, sage green and slate blue, and a wicker laundry basket at the foot of a post. High top-down view on a 2:1 isometric axis. Dark brown 1 pixel outline, muted warm earth colours, 3 to 4 flat tone steps per material, warm light from the upper left, matte, no white or near-white pixels, no gloss, no bevelled plank edges, no text.

note: family round 2 (Route A at G1): blockout, text edit
